title: Brightness and persistence can trade off
original_forecast: Compare reported relative intensity and decay state over time. A brighter initial display must not be described as a larger total chemical yield without an independently supported photon/energy balance.
original_limitations: The emission rate is a bounded temperature-dependent observable. Sampling points do not guarantee equal accumulated photons or fully consumed molecular reactants.

question.original_criterion: Does warming a chemically emitting formulation increase its immediate intensity while shortening its persistence?
question.original_instruction: Compare reported relative intensity and decay state over time. A brighter initial display must not be described as a larger total chemical yield without an independently supported photon/energy balance.
question.assessment: Warm prepared formulation is initially brighter with shorter declared half-life; later cold arm persists more strongly. Each sample is independently reconstructed from owned formulation,peroxide,activation lot,time andactualchangingtemperature, not nominal fixed15/40C. Separate peroxide/water/retainedO2 ledger closes; no total accumulated photons, molecular yield or glow energy balance is inferred.

inventory.original_criterion: Account for explicit additions, retained and transferred material, unresolved pools, and any gas/solvent loss before interpreting the result.
inventory.original_instruction: Compare all reported inventories and event-level source/sink terms; a successful exit alone is not a chemistry pass.
inventory.assessment: Explicit additions, pinned recipe expansion, all resolved elemental/charge ownership, exact unresolved aggregate mass, actual contained gas and sealed dry air. CO008 additionally owns allCa/Na/declared soap-ligand equivalents, with no invented aggregate molecularformula. No gas export or unknown event admitted. Free-ion readback is not counted twice over analytical basis contents.
